title.en: An Act Declaring September 8 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Entire Country to Commemorate the Feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary

text.en: September 8 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the entire country to commemorate the Feast of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
